native_resolution_binding.details: New code_root binds all 34 packaged files; base_code_root and real STTrack repository paths retain inherited pins including m121_dense_inputs, native tracker, preprocessor, data loader and backbone dependencies.

static_receiver.details: Pinned zip and all 98+8 path hashes checked by stdlib-only receiver before staging receipt; retained receipt declares no launch or GPU query.

hourly_admission_helper.details: Requires exactly one observation query, zero NN forward, >=3600 seconds since recorded admission, both device rows 0/1 below 500 MiB, old complete statuses and exit 0. Remote code requires nonfuture snapshot age <=300 seconds, earliest admission time, matching pins and old exit 0. No extra GPU query or refresh is added.

complete_training_callchain.details: Admission -> m123_joint_process_supervisor -> run_m123_joint_full_suite -> train_m123_ABC_joint_full152. Unchanged trainer runs all official Train152 for fixed three passes, then prepares three official evaluations from the same fixed final. No new pilot, split, cached-feature fitting stage, preflight or automatic retry is reached.

limitations: Only local source reads, byte hashes, archive inspection and AST parsing were performed. No SSH, network, NN import/construction, forward/backward, GPU query, training or evaluation was executed.
The actual future hourly observation was not supplied to or consumed by this review. The helper freshness and single-query guards are verified source logic, not an actual admission certificate.
The local static stdout is a retained staging receipt. Its package/gate hashes match the reviewed local bytes; this review did not recontact the remote receiver or verify current remote state.

All 64 inherited source pins were matched to retained or development local source bytes. Remote files, GPU availability, dataset images, binary weights and installed framework/kernel binaries were not rehashed or exercised afresh.
AST feature_version 3.8 parsing used local Python 3.11.14. It is neither an actual Python 3.8 execution test nor a neural/GPU test.

The 34 code files are byte-identical to the sealed original source scope plus its eight local import dependencies. This bounded follow-up rechecks deployment binding and launch call chain; it does not claim an independent reimplementation of the prior full semantic audit.
No M123 training completion, successful optimizer update, gradient flow at runtime, exact final roundtrip, metric, efficacy or convergence is certified.
Reviewer backend identity is unattested. Requested model/effort is gpt-6-astra/max; same-family review remains provisional.
